description: Turn complex work into inspectable, verified execution graphs.

defaultPrompt: Audit this repository against its implementation plan.
Implement the requested feature and verify it.
Research these options using parallel evidence gathering.
interface.longDescription:
Graph Mode turns complex tasks into transparent, dependency-aware execution graphs instead of relying on an open-ended agent loop.

It breaks work into explicit nodes with dependencies, access levels, expected outputs, evidence requirements, attempt limits, and clear statuses. Graph Mode can run independent research or inspection branches in parallel, safely join their results, verify completion with deterministic evidence, and perform one bounded repair cycle when verification fails.

Use it for repository audits, feature implementation, parallel research, maker-reviewer workflows, monitoring, and other multi-step tasks where control flow and proof of completion matter.

Graph Mode does not expand the user’s permissions or scope. External writes, destructive actions, and materially ambiguous decisions remain approval-gated. Every run ends with a clear terminal state and reports the executed path, evidence, changes, blockers, skipped branches, and remaining uncertainty.

name: graph-mode
